title: EYI image collection inventory (268 images, ~sampled)
body: The EYI package bundles 268 images totaling ~151.4MB. Directory breakdown: {'user/media_library/image': 187, 'user/media_library/browser_screenshots': 46, 'goals/draftkings-week-2-dfs-lineup/files': 11, 'goals/fsa-reimbursement-sweep/files': 6, 'goals/galaxy-sports-edge-viral-video-operation/files': 2, 'goals/x-engagement-farming-for-galaxysportshq/files': 2, 'your_files/gse-ios-audit/contact-sheet.png': 1, 'your_files/gse-ios-audit/frame-calibration.png': 1}. A 6-image stratified sample (4 media_library, 2 browser_screenshots, 2 goal-file graphics) showed four content classes: (1) GSE engine artifacts — Minis-app 'Overnight GSE Engine Test Run' screenshots (DeepSeek V4.1 Flash verdicts, L2/L3 blocked-file lists, Step 0 delivery notes), Week 2 DFS 'MAX CEILING' lineup cards (Dak Prescott / Kenneth Walker III / Javonte Williams / CeeDee Lamb / George Pickens / DK Metcalf / Isaiah Likely / Jake Ferguson / Buccaneers DST, $50,000 cap-exact, LineStar 15-game ownership, Dallas-stack pivot note), Steelers-Browns TNF box-score screenshots (Rodgers 21/36 296 yds 2TD 1INT; Metcalf 5-115; final CLE 24 PIT 16); (2) research saves — Instagram/X screenshots (MiniCPM open-source model release notes; YouTube-automation operator posts); (3) Kit-lane design references — web-agency homepage screenshots (e.g. SPINX 'Ready to transform your brand's digital home'); (4) personal material — Gmail screenshots (incl. Fanatics Collect case correspondence), DMs, receipts. Classes 1-3 are GSE-relevant; class 4 is personal and was not transcribed. RECOMMENDATION: a dedicated per-image caption pass over the 268 images (parallelizable) would recover the engine-relevant screenshots' full text; the 6 sampled descriptions below are the verified starting set.

title: EYI image sample: Minis-app 'Overnight GSE Engine Test Run' verdict screenshot
body: Phone screenshot of the Minis app showing an 'Overnight GSE Engine Test Run' report (model: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash via OpenRouter). Key verdicts: 'L2 blocked, exact files: /tmp/nfl/player_stats_*.csv — zero results; rosters and /tmp/sched.csv present.' 'L3 blocked: /tmp/nfl/snap_counts_*.csv — nothing; only repo fixtures (snap_counts_sample.json); no book prop lines exist on this host — and L3's estimand is the pricing gap, so it's untestable here.' 'Step 0: delivered, 24 files, nothing lost, both mirrors.' Also notes: push requires Garrett's word (block is local-only); earlier AGENTS.md notes (v5.3.0 direct-to-production findings) were wiped when the clone reset mid-session and the file reverted to 57,939 bytes. Relevance: concrete engine-test evidence — missing data dependencies (player_stats, snap_counts, book prop lines) blocking L2/L3 on the Windows host.
